findings.title: Malformed project id with no task now exits 2 instead of GO
findings.body: dispatch-desk tools/gate.py:31 rejects a project id outside ledger.ID before reading the ledger; the CLI exits 2. The hook maps exit 2 to UNKNOWN and still allows work. Accepted by the owner in chat 2026-11-26: "Accept F1 as is".

remaining_risks: Same-uid replacement of the temp copy is possible after the write and before python -I reads it; mkdtemp mode is 0700.
_read_verified has no deadline; a blocking ledger.py can stall session start before UNKNOWN.
rmtree with ignore_errors can leave the temp directory; subprocess timeout does not reap the child.
No committed test runs the pinned gate bytes through the temp-copy path; the supervisor end-to-end run did.
The client pins dispatch-desk 84bff89, so it reports UNKNOWN until hu3mann/dispatch-desk#1 is merged and installed.
